remarks:
New Price! Priced to sell quickly! Welcome to 81 Dorris Ave, a spacious Buffalo two-family home offering an excellent opportunity for investors or owner-occupants. The attractive vinyl exterior features a welcoming front porch on the first floor and a private second-floor balcony, creating appealing outdoor spaces for each unit.

Inside, the upper and lower apartments each offer a functional 4-bedroom, 1-bath layout with generous living space and room for a variety of household needs. Recent updates include new flooring, fresh interior paint, and renovated kitchens and bathrooms, providing a clean and refreshed feel throughout both units. Each apartment is separately metered, adding convenience for tenants and helping streamline utility management.

Additional improvements include a new roof installed approximately one year ago and new water heaters, offering important updates for the next owner. The vinyl exterior provides low-maintenance appeal, while the front porch and second-floor balcony add valuable outdoor space.

Located in Buffalo, this property offers convenient access to shopping, dining, parks, public transportation, and everyday amenities. With two spacious 4-bedroom units, updated interiors, separate metering, and recent major improvements, 81 Dorris Ave presents a versatile opportunity in a convenient neighborhood setting.
